title: DEF CON 26  - Christopher Domas - The Ring 0 Facade Awakening the Processors Inner Demons
summary: Christopher Domas's DEF CON 26 talk on secret processor registers that vendors reserve for third parties holding trusted keys. He examines how users are locked out of parts of their own CPUs.
why: HN commenters call his x86 internals talks spectacular and mention them whenever low-level processor surprises come up.

quote.text: I remember watching his Defcon talks on x86 shenanigans[^1][^2] and being amazed at what he's been able to discover
